## findings

- **T0-1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED + SOURCE-TASK RED (undeclared override, `_difficulty.md` F1).** Symptom: the billing-error credit has two defensible amounts. Root cause: `parking_ext_billing_error_correction.overwrite: []` while its rule changes the amount fixed by base `parking_evt_late_fee_and_waiver` "A late fee posted against a period paid within grace is a billing error and is credited as billing_error_correction ...". Evidence: base sentence vs BEC rule "The billing-error correction credit is the erroneous late fee in full, as it was posted, plus a service-recovery amount ... the correction credit is the erroneous late fee plus the service-recovery amount plus any inconvenience allowance"; seed fee `b6f46216` amount 30.0. Consequence: second reading credit **30.00** (gold 62.05) and payment **414.00** (gold 381.95). Affected: `parking.extended.yaml` extended_policies[parking_ext_billing_error_correction].overwrite; gold steps 11 and 15. Relation to previous revisions: first audit.
- **T0-2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (cross-difficulty rows contradict the autopay charter).** Symptom: CON's `autopay_record_share` takes the "active ∧ declined" tier on an authorization the autopay charter would have suspended. Root cause: seed `autopay_enrollments.7b41f2c9-bc7c-406e-bff4-3b80cd09f8db` `status: active`, `suspension_date: ""`, `next_draft_due_date: 2025-10-14` after two consecutive failed due dates. Evidence: `autopay.yaml` `autopay_evt_retry_and_suspension` "Otherwise the authorization is suspended when autopay_msr_consecutive_failed_due_dates reaches consecutive_failures_to_suspend"; Debit Card `consecutive_failures_to_suspend: 2`; drafts `efa78abb` (due 2025-08-14, only attempt, NSF) and `25431c38`/`6de574af` (due 2025-09-14, both NSF). Consequence: with the charter-consistent status the tier is "no active authorization" (0) and the concession is **210.90** instead of 210.66. Affected: initial_state autopay_enrollments row; gold step 17. (Also missing: the August retry the same rule requires; no scored value moves.)
